concepts.title: The Paralympic Games
concepts.definition: The text introduces the Paralympic Games, a global stage where athletes with locomotor, sensory or intellectual disabilities defy the odds and showcase exceptional skill - a celebration of resilience, training and extraordinary talent.
concepts.key_idea: Disability is no disqualification: the Paralympics rewrite the limits of sport.
concepts.textbook_ref: iebe105.txt sections on the Paralympic Games

solution_steps.explain: An international sports event for athletes with disabilities.
Locomotor, sensory and intellectual disabilities shape the events.
Training and willpower, not disability, define the athletes.

concepts.title: Sheetal Devi - An Interview of Courage
concepts.definition: The interview with Sheetal Devi, the para-archer honoured with the Arjuna Award in January 2024, shows a young athlete who turned physical challenge into world-class archery through grit, practice and self-belief.
concepts.key_idea: One interview, one message: determination draws the perfect arrow.
question_patterns: who is Sheetal Devi - describe her achievement
what challenges did Sheetal Devi overcome to become a para-archer
how did the Arjuna Award change her life - discuss
what does the interview reveal about her training
which quality of Sheetal Devi inspires you most - why
what message does Sheetal Devi give to young people

solution_steps.explain: From a small village to international archery glory.
Adapted technique, relentless practice and confidence.
Her story argues that limits live in minds, not bodies.

concepts.title: Theme - Limitless Possibilities
concepts.definition: The chapter's title states its theme: human possibility is limitless when determination meets opportunity; athletes with disabilities expand society's definition of what bodies and minds can achieve.
concepts.key_idea: Limits are suggestions, not laws: the chapter asks readers to expand them.
question_patterns: why is the chapter titled The World of Limitless Possibilities
how do Paralympic athletes expand our idea of possibility
what attitudes towards disability does the chapter question
how can schools support athletes with disabilities
connect the chapter's message to a personal challenge
what does resilience mean - explain with examples from the text

solution_steps.explain: Ability is measured by effort and spirit, not by the body alone.
Paralympians and Sheetal Devi personify the limitless.
Readers should chase their own possibilities with equal grit.
